name: Ordda ko-Brindle
bio: Bone-smith on Kharrow's third ledge and the fourth to carry the name Ordda, which comes with the bench and not with the mother; she faces clan plate and backs clan bows with giant-bone off the Brindlecrag scree and has never sold a split of it down the pass.
unique_habit: Weighs every piece of bone before she cuts it and after, keeps the difference in a horn cup, and walks the dust back up the scree when there is a handful of it.

appearance.notes: bone dust worked white into the creases of both hands, a horn cup on a thong at the belt, one Brindle token among a hold full of Kharrow ones

schedule.notes: the Rope-Song, at the back, half a beat behind
standing, over the work, which Dunna has mentioned
restringing the bridge-wardens' bows, badly paid, done anyway

name: Sorrel Lathe
bio: Makes the paid watch's crossbows under guild charter at the canal end of Lantern Row, and has cut the brass tally-plate into every stock that has left her counter since she was twenty-three.
unique_habit: Knows every watchman in Tollmere by the number on their stock instead of their face, greets them by it, and apologises for it immediately every time.

appearance.notes: brass filings in the apron seam, a hand-vice hung where a purse would be, a register open on the counter with a weight on the page

schedule.notes: laths first, while the shop is cold
the register, the numbers, and whoever is arguing about a string
reading the morning's prices out loud to whoever cannot
